Now let me measure peak memory for the big campaign (26.7 MiB input, 800 runs × 1600 objects). Let me write the campaign JSON to a file (in /workspace/tmp) and run the CLI with memory tracking via the `resource` module in a wrapper (subprocess + ru_maxrss via os.wait4 or resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN)).

Let me do it.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tail -6
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit
src = open('t_big.py').read().replace('out = kit.run_cli(campaign)', 'out = None')
ns = {}
exec(src.split('data = json.dumps(campaign)')[0], ns)
campaign = ns["campaign"]
data = json.dumps(campaign)
print("input MiB %.1f" % (len(data) / 2 ** 20))
before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
start = time.time()
proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", kit.CLI], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        env={**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"})
out, err = proc.communicate(data.encode())
after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
print("exit", proc.returncode, "wall %.2fs" % (time.time() - start))
print("peak child RSS %.0f MiB" % (after / 1024))
value = json.loads(out)
print("records", len(value["records"]), "corpus", len(value["corpus"]),
      "statuses", {r["status"] for r in value["records"]})
PYEOF
